nodes.name: Post-call webhook
nodes.notes: Fires after a dialer call ends (Preview/Power/3-Line - live call placement itself is Phase 5/Telnyx-gated, but this synthesis step is pure data processing and doesn't need a live call to exist to be built). Input contract: {opportunityId, callId, transcriptOrNotes}. Where transcriptOrNotes comes from (Telnyx call recording + transcription, or manual agent notes) isn't decided - Phase 5 scope, not this workflow's.

nodes.name: Synthesize (Claude, structured output)

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ model: 'claude-opus-5', max_tokens: 1024, system: [{ type: 'text', text: 'You synthesize sales call transcripts into a strict 5-key summary for a CRM. Disposition must be one of: Connected-Interested, Connected-NotInterested, Callback, NoAnswer, Busy, GatekeeperOnly, WrongNumber, VoicemailLeft, OptOut. Callback (a lead asked for a specific personal follow-up) is its own value, not a Connected- prefixed one - it locks the record to this rep rather than the general Connected/no-contact split. "Try-Back Time" is a specific ISO datetime or null if none was given. "DM Presence" is true only if you spoke with the actual decision-maker, not a gatekeeper. "Rebuttal After Decline" is true only if the rep continued pitching/persuading after the lead gave a clear decline ("no", "not interested", "stop calling", etc.) rather than ending the call - this is a compliance flag, be conservative: a single clarifying question after an ambiguous response is not a rebuttal, a renewed sales pitch after an unambiguous no is.', cache_control: { type: 'ephemeral' } }], messages: [{ role: 'user', content: 'Call transcript/notes:\n\n' + $json.body.transcriptOrNotes }], output_config: { format: { type: 'json_schema', schema: { type: 'object', properties: { Disposition: { type: 'string' }, Summary: { type: 'string' }, 'Try-Back Time': { type: ['string', 'null'] }, 'DM Presence': { type: 'boolean' }, 'Rebuttal After Decline': { type: 'boolean' } }, required: ['Disposition', 'Summary', 'Try-Back Time', 'DM Presence', 'Rebuttal After Decline'] } } } }) }}

nodes.notes: The brief gives this exact 4-key contract (Disposition/Summary/Try-Back Time/DM Presence) in 05 Section 4 - encoded directly via output_config.format's json_schema (Structured Outputs, per the claude-api skill's current guidance - NOT the deprecated output_format parameter some older examples use), so the response is guaranteed well-formed rather than parsed out of free text. cache_control on the static system instructions, per the brief's 'prompt caching is required, not optional' rule - the per-call transcript is the only thing that varies, kept out of the cached block. Model is claude-opus-5 to stay consistent with the rest of this codebase's Claude calls; worth reconsidering a lighter/faster model here given this runs on every single call rather than once per lead, which claude-opus-5 wasn't necessarily sized for. Credential referenced as 'Claude API' (n8n httpHeaderAuth, header name x-api-key) - same CLAUDE_API_KEY the Command Center writes.

nodes.name: Extract structured result
nodes.notes: With output_config.format set, Claude's text block IS the JSON (not prose containing JSON) - this just unwraps the SDK/API response envelope down to that object. Throws (routing to errorWorkflow) rather than silently passing through malformed data if the text block is missing.

nodes.name: Write to Opportunity

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ lastCallDisposition: $json.Disposition, lastCallSummary: $json.Summary, lastCallTryBackTime: $json['Try-Back Time'], lastCallDmPresence: $json['DM Presence'], lastCallRebuttalFlag: $json['Rebuttal After Decline'] }) }}

nodes.notes: A short structured summary written directly onto the Opportunity is CRM-native data (like the e-sign fields), not 'embedded live data from another tool' in the Opportunity Card sense - the full transcript itself should live in the Communications Hub (W2.5, not yet built) or wherever call recordings are stored, referenced by a link, not dumped here. Same Twenty CRM REST-shape uncertainty as every workflow in this library. CONFIRMED unchanged by the object model migration (CRM-OBJECT-MODEL.md): a sales call is about advancing a specific deal, so it stays Opportunity-anchored regardless of pre- or post-sale timing. lastCallRebuttalFlag is new this pass - the global no-rebuttal-after-decline compliance policy's QA signal, see CRM-OBJECT-MODEL.md's Compliance layer section.

nodes.name: Rebuttal flagged?
nodes.notes: Fire-and-forget branch relative to 'Respond' (same pattern as W1.6's Location-status-update branch) - a flagged rebuttal doesn't need to block or slow the caller's response, it needs a compliance reviewer alerted.

nodes.name: Alert: compliance review needed

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ severity: 'warning', source: 'post-call-synthesis', message: 'Possible rebuttal-after-decline on Opportunity ' + $('Post-call webhook').item.json.body.opportunityId + ' (call ' + $('Post-call webhook').item.json.body.callId + ') - no-rebuttal is a global policy, needs a compliance review.' }) }}

nodes.notes: Calls the real alert-dispatcher workflow (phase-2-calendar-nurture-alerts/alert-dispatcher.workflow.json) by its webhook path, same pattern as referral-trigger.workflow.json - internal alert, reversible, auto-executed per the automation risk boundary (this flags a possible violation for human review, it doesn't itself take any external or disciplinary action).
